description: Source-lore pass 13 imports the ten airship classes and five cultural flight traditions.

entries.title: Airships and Vessels
entries.summary: Kaysender airships range from tiny scout craft to fortress-scale dreadnoughts, with hull purpose, cultural flight technology, crew, cargo, weapons, and modification defining every vessel.
body: Airships are Kaysender's connective infrastructure. They carry people, food, [[water-trade|water]], freight, military force, tribute, messages, explorers, pirates, and refugees between [[floating-islands|floating islands]].

The standard class ladder runs from the tiny [[jetty-airship|Jetty]] and utility [[scutter-airship|Scutter]] through Corvettes, Frigates, Cruisers, Liners, Destroyers, Galleons, Battleships, and the immense [[dreadnought-airship|Dreadnought]]. Each step increases crew, cargo, armament, durability, operating burden, and political significance while generally sacrificing speed and maneuverability.

A vessel class is only a foundation. Construction yards alter armor, weapons, speed, cargo, accommodations, and purpose. Cultural traditions further reshape flight: Human steam-aether hybrids, Fae levitation and lightwinds, Dwager runic stonecraft, Gezistack clockwork-arcane machinery, and Dragon Kin elemental power produce visibly different ships.

Every airship is therefore both machine and social space. Its core, crew, stores, morale, ownership deed, maintenance history, route, armament, passengers, cargo, and faction ties determine what it can do and what trouble follows it.

sections.heading: Legacy Scale
body: The source assigns armor, speed, cargo volume, weapon counts, crew capacities, special attacks, defenses, and modification effects to all ten classes. Those numerical values remain indexed in their class entries pending conversion.

sourceRefs.outlineTitle: Airships / Airship Classes: Types and Base Information

entries.title: Jetty Airship
entries.summary: A Jetty is a tiny, fast, agile scout or personal transport, often little more than an aerial rowboat with a cabin.
body: Jetties serve reconnaissance, fast transport, scouting, and personal travel. They normally carry only a few people and very light cargo, and many are operated by a single pilot.

A standard Jetty is unarmed but can accept small guns, telescopes, navigation tools, espionage devices, or other scout equipment. Its survival depends on stealth, speed, and avoiding sustained combat.

sections.heading: Legacy Vessel Profile
body: The source lists AC 12 plus Dexterity, speed 120 feet, 10 cubic feet of cargo, crew 2-4, stealth maneuvering, and a limited speed burst. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Scutter Airship
entries.summary: A Scutter is a nimble small utility and skirmish vessel equally suited to fishing, short missions, and light combat.
body: Scutters are versatile small craft with enough space for a modest crew, light freight, and basic weapons. Without armament, many would resemble practical fishing or utility vessels.
Their maneuverability supports rapid course changes and shielding nets. Construction yards commonly add cargo space, light turrets, or trap systems.

sections.heading: Legacy Vessel Profile
body: The source lists AC 13 plus Dexterity, speed 100 feet, 20 cubic feet of cargo, two light cannons, crew 4-6, rapid maneuvers, and shielding nets. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Corvette Airship
entries.summary: A Corvette is a compact agile warship used for offense, defense, scouting, and fleet engagements.
body: Corvettes are the smallest purpose-built fleet combat vessels. They combine light cannons and anti-air ballistas with enough agility to defend larger ships or threaten vulnerable targets.
Typical modifications include armor plating, grappling hooks, boarding devices, extra weapons, smoke, and flare countermeasures.

sections.heading: Legacy Vessel Profile
body: The source lists AC 15, speed 90 feet, 30 cubic feet of cargo, four light cannons, two anti-air ballistas, crew 6-8, rapid-fire salvos, and countermeasures. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Frigate Airship
entries.summary: A Frigate is a balanced patrol and combat vessel used to escort larger ships and overpower smaller craft.
body: Frigates balance patrol endurance, combat power, and fleet support. Their medium cannon batteries and anti-air weapons make them credible escorts and independent enforcement vessels.
Command systems, extra engines, communication equipment, and bombardment weapons are common modifications.

sections.heading: Legacy Vessel Profile
body: The source lists AC 16, speed 80 feet, 50 cubic feet of cargo, six medium cannons, two anti-air guns, crew 8-12, a command aura, and focused fire. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Cruiser Airship
entries.summary: A Cruiser is a heavy multipurpose vessel combining sustained firepower, strategic support, cargo, and defensive capability.
body: Cruisers operate as heavy combat and support ships. They carry heavy cannons, ballistas, and siege weapons while retaining enough capacity for strategic cargo or passengers.
Their common modifications include expanded cargo, magical shields, hull reinforcement, and long-range artillery.

sections.heading: Legacy Vessel Profile
body: The source lists AC 17, speed 70 feet, 90 cubic feet of cargo, four heavy cannons, two ballistas, one siege weapon, crew 15-25, fire support, and temporary hull reinforcement. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Liner Airship
entries.summary: A Liner is a large passenger, luxury, freight, convoy, or exploration vessel with extensive accommodations and cargo capacity.
body: Liners are built to move many passengers or large freight loads in relative comfort. They serve merchant convoys, long-distance travel, exploration, and mobile-base roles.
Most are unarmed when built, but construction yards can add defensive cannons, transport machinery, comfort enchantments, or other specialized accommodations.

sections.heading: Legacy Vessel Profile
body: The source lists AC 14, speed 60 feet, 150 cubic feet of cargo, crew 30-50, passenger-comfort benefits, and no standard weapons. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Destroyer Airship
entries.summary: A Destroyer is a heavily armed escort and assault vessel built for intense fleet combat.
body: Destroyers protect larger ships and confront dangerous opponents directly. Heavy cannon batteries, anti-air weapons, and torpedoes give them broad offensive coverage.
They commonly receive additional armor, pursuit engines, and more weapon mounts, turning their already high operating burden toward decisive combat.

sections.heading: Legacy Vessel Profile
body: The source lists AC 18, speed 60 feet, 300 cubic feet of cargo, eight heavy cannons, four anti-air weapons, two torpedoes, crew 30-40, an all-out barrage, and counterstrikes. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Galleon Airship
entries.summary: A Galleon is a colossal flagship, battleship, troop carrier, or heavy freighter combining massive cargo with formidable weapons.
body: Galleons combine scale, firepower, defense, and freight capacity. They can act as flagships, merchant capitals, troop carriers, or massive combat platforms.
Their size supports command bridges, siege weapons, extensive armor, harpoons, and large crews, making every Galleon a major political and logistical presence.

sections.heading: Legacy Vessel Profile
body: The source lists AC 20, speed 50 feet, 600 cubic feet of cargo, twelve heavy cannons, four ballistas, two harpoons, crew 50-100, supreme barrage, and imperial command. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Battleship Airship
entries.summary: A Battleship is an iconic fleet-leading war vessel built to dominate sustained engagements through armor, siege weapons, torpedoes, and command.
body: Battleships are floating declarations of military power. They lead fleets, anchor battle lines, carry siege cannons and heavy defenses, and coordinate allied vessels.
Advanced shields, arcane engines, enchanted cannons, and tactical command systems are natural extensions of the class.

sections.heading: Legacy Vessel Profile
body: The source lists AC 22, speed 40 feet, 900 cubic feet of cargo, eight siege cannons, six heavy ballistae, four torpedoes, two area-defense cannons, crew 100-200, tactical supremacy, and a massive salvo. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Dreadnought Airship
entries.summary: A Dreadnought is the largest and most powerful warship class, intended to lead battles and overwhelm opposition through extraordinary resilience and weaponry.
body: Dreadnoughts are fortress-scale instruments of dominance. Their super-heavy weapons, armor, enormous crews, and modification capacity make them strategic assets rather than ordinary vessels.

They can support orbital or super-siege weapons, heavy torpedoes, arcane systems, defensive networks, extensive accommodations, and mission-specific reconstruction. Their operation consumes immense resources and demands an equally immense shipyard and organization.

sections.heading: Legacy Vessel Profile
body: The source lists AC 24, speed 30 feet, 1,000 cubic feet of cargo, super-siege and orbital cannons, heavy torpedoes and ballistae, crew 200-500, a final assault, and extreme durability. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Human Aetheric and Steam Flight
entries.summary: Human vessels combine aetheric runes, mechanical gears, fuel boilers, turbines, and practical maintenance into versatile hybrid airships.
body: Human flight uses aetheric engines alongside steam power. Magical runes harness ambient aether while coal- or fuel-driven boilers turn turbines for thrust and stability.

Human ships are practical, balanced, noisy, and comparatively maintainable. Steam turbines and stored aether provide bursts of speed, while smoke can expose a vessel at long range. Their machinery requires skilled crews and is vulnerable to electrical disruption.

sections.heading: Legacy Construction Modifiers
body: The source provides balanced performance bonuses, maintenance failure rates, lightning weakness, wreck thresholds, speed bursts, and smoke-detection modifiers. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Elven Arcane Levitation and Lightwinds
entries.summary: Elven vessels use levitation magic, wind elementals, lightwind sails, silverleaf wood, and moonstone to achieve graceful, fast, nearly smokeless flight.
body: Elven flight relies on arcane levitation and control of natural winds rather than heavy engines. Lightweight enchanted materials, wind elementals, lightwind sails, and levitation stones produce elegant and highly maneuverable vessels.
These ships excel at exploration, ceremonial journeys, and fast strikes. Their grace and resistance to force or lightning come at the price of fragile hulls and vulnerability to fire.

sections.heading: Legacy Construction Modifiers
body: The source supplies speed, maneuverability, armor, resistance, fire weakness, destruction threshold, lightwind, weight reduction, wing, and stealth modifiers. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Dwarven Rune-Enchanted Stonecraft Flight
entries.summary: Dwarven vessels use dense stone, mithril, adamantium, runic engines, steam, and redundant levitation to create slow but extraordinarily durable ships.
body: Dwarven airships reject lightness in favor of rune-enchanted stonecraft and heavy steam machinery. Dense materials, reinforced hulls, runic engines, and gravitational effects keep immense vessels aloft.

They are slow and difficult to maneuver but exceptionally resilient, suited to war, heavy cargo, industrial work, and dangerous missions. Redundant levitation keeps damaged ships floating long after lighter craft would be lost.

sections.heading: Legacy Construction Modifiers
body: The source supplies speed and maneuverability penalties, armor, damage reduction, resistances, negative-hit-point sinking rules, engine reliability, shields, and stealth modifiers. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Gnomish Mechanized and Arcane Flight
entries.summary: Gnomish vessels combine clockwork wings, gear-driven engines, rare crystals, arcane fuel, and gadgets into compact, maneuverable, highly customizable craft.
body: Gnomish flight blends machinery and arcane tinkering. Clockwork wings, gear-driven engines, crystals, magical fuel, turrets, screens, and experimental systems create adaptable vessels with remarkable control.
The same complexity that permits extra gadgets also makes these ships fragile and potentially unreliable. Some produce revealing smoke, and many depend on constant adjustment by skilled engineers.

sections.heading: Legacy Construction Modifiers
body: The source supplies maneuverability and armor modifiers, tool bonuses, extra feature capacity, propulsion, arcane-fuel bursts, gadget bonuses, smoke detection, and destruction thresholds. Conversion is required.

sourceRefs.outlineTitle: Gnomes: Mechanized and Arcane Hybrid Flight

entries.title: Dragonborn Draconic Elemental Flight
entries.summary: Dragonborn vessels channel draconic magic through heartstones, elemental cores, breath engines, fire wings, and lightning sails.
body: Dragonborn airships bind draconic and elemental force into heartstones or great magical crystals. Their hulls and propulsion systems express fire, lightning, wind, earth, or other aspects of dragonkind.

These ships combine respectable speed with strong construction, elemental resistance, intimidating presence, and short bursts of breath-like power. Their design is inseparable from Dragon Kin authority and elemental identity.

sections.heading: Legacy Construction Modifiers
body: The source supplies speed, armor, elemental resistance, social modifiers, breath-engine attacks and bursts, elemental sail effects, and related performance values. Conversion is required.
